body:
## Summary
PMF Engine is now an **AI venture studio**. Several founder agents each run their own company at the same time: each one finds a real problem in public complaints, builds and ships a working web product, finds users, and keeps it, iterates on it, or kills it and pivots based on what users actually do. The goal is real users.

**It is deployed and running now:** https://pmf-2rdynba3hkaq.vercel.app

| Founder | Market | Company (so far) |
|---|---|---|
| founder-1 | developers and indie hackers | CORSfix: paste a CORS error, get the fix for your backend (live) |
| founder-2 | freelancers and small businesses | PayNudge: payment-reminder emails that escalate as an invoice gets more overdue (live) |
| founder-3 | students and creators | CramPlan (building) |

### What's in it
- **Studio app** (`server/`, `sql/`):
  - `/` is the public dashboard of every company, user counts, versions, decisions, reports and human step-ins.
  - `/c/<slug>` is each company's page: the problem with links to the real threads, a **Tests** table with each shipped version's own numbers, decisions, outreach and feedback.
  - Products are served at `/p/<slug>/` with a small JSON backend (`window.pmf.db`) and analytics (`/t.js`).
- **Required detailed reports** (`/r/<id>`, `/reports`): the app refuses an iterate, scale or kill decision unless it comes with a structured write-up (hypothesis, what we built, how we tested it, results, what users said, what we learned, and the decision). The studio's own numbers are attached to every report.
- **Decision rules** (`server/rules.ts`): each company gets a verdict of `stalled`, `too_early`, `no_reach`, `iterate`, `keep` or `scale`, computed from unique visitors, people who did the core action, and people who came back.
- **Crew** (`crew/crew.ts`): 3 founders on staggered 30-minute schedules, plus a concierge that owns the shared inbox.
- **Fixes from the first live run:**
  - Founders ship straight from their sandbox through short-lived upload links (`get_upload_link`). This was tested in production with a 150 KB file.
  - Placeholder files are refused, and a broken live product is flagged to its founder.
  - A run lock stops two runs of one founder from overlapping.
  - Founders' own test visits (`?qa=1`) are left out of the user counts.
  - There's a fallback for when web search is rate-limited.
- **Anonymity:** agents never reveal who runs the studio, and this repository now commits under a neutral identity.
- `scripts/fence-ceo.ts` keeps the organization's built-in CEO orchestrator out of the studio's tools. It needs an admin key, see below.

Note: `sql/0001_init.sql` changed before its first deploy. It's now applied in production, so later schema changes go in new numbered files (as `0002` and `0003` already do).

## What we need from you
1. **A new Naïve API key with every permission**, including `billing:read`, `billing:write` and `admin`, created in the Studio (app.usenaive.ai). The current key can only manage agents and sessions, so it can't turn on social posting, read the credit balance, or fence the CEO agent. **Never paste the key in this PR, in chat, or in a commit.** Save it locally in `key.txt`, which git ignores.
2. **A fresh, anonymous X account** for the studio, plus Bluesky, Threads, LinkedIn or Mastodon if possible. Once the new key is in, we'll generate a sign-in link, and the account owner signs in once. Please don't use a personal account: every post goes out under it. Until something is connected, founders can only reach people by email.
3. **Confirm the ~$250 of Naïve credit** shows in the Studio. Agent spending is capped at about $130/day in total (`BUDGETS` in `crew/crew.ts`).
4. **Review**, especially the founder prompt in `crew/crew.ts` and the guardrails in `server/mcp.ts`: quotas, the 7-day no-repeat rule, opt-outs, one company per founder, and size limits.

## Test plan
- [x] `npm test`: 35 tests covering the whole studio against an in-process Postgres, including the real tracker script running in a browser-like sandbox
- [x] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`
- [x] Deployed with `naive up`: persona, inbox, app with database and 3 migrations, 4 agents, 3 schedules
- [x] Production checks: dashboard, MCP auth (401 without the platform token), upload path end to end (the test data was removed)
- [x] Live: two products shipped and working within ~15 minutes of kickoff
- [ ] Turn on social posting and connect X (needs the new key and the account)
- [ ] Fence the CEO agent (`npm run fence-ceo`, needs the admin key)
- [ ] First real users, and the first iterate, scale or kill reports

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

commits.messageBody:
Several founder agents each run their own company in parallel: find a
real problem in public complaints, build and ship a working web product,
find users, and iterate, kill or pivot on what users actually do.

- Studio app: public dashboard, per-company pages with a per-version
  test table, required detailed reports (/r/<id>, /reports), products
  served at /p/<slug>/ with a small JSON backend and analytics
- Founders ship straight from their sandbox through short-lived upload
  links; placeholders are refused and broken live products flagged
- Run lock so two runs of one founder never overlap; founders' own
  test visits (?qa=1) excluded from user counts
- Concierge owns the shared inbox; agents keep the studio anonymous
- fence-ceo script keeps the org's orchestrator out of studio tools

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: Rebuild PMF Engine as an AI venture studio, live on Naïve

commits.messageBody:
- Rule 7: founders never create accounts, sign up or log in on other
  sites; the founders' browser also pauses on login and saved logins
- Every studio answer carries a test_url (?qa=1) so founders' own
  checks never count as users
- Events record the browser's user agent (migration 0004) to tell
  automated visits from people

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: Block account sign-ups, add founder test links, record user agents

commits.messageBody:
The app refuses an iterate decision while a company's verdict is still
too_early, building or stalled; founders log keep and push distribution.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: Only close a test with iterate once there is data to judge it
